name: ticket update https://projects.zoho.com/portal/webriqusa#buginfo/1512955000008348114/1512955000014320013

notes:
1. Investigated a reported issue on the hlwc.ph website by navigating through its Netlify hosting dashboard and inspecting the project configuration and environment variables for the site address and the content platform address.
  2. Messaged Mariel F about the issue and worked through it together to narrow down the cause.
  3. Cloned the project locally and fixed the bug from the local copy.
  4. Noticed the project was still configured to run on an outdated runtime version (Node 16); updating it to the current version (Node 22) fixed the server error the site was hitting on AWS Lambda.
  5. Notified April that the issue was fixed and marked it resolved.
